title: review: C-O6b: fallback capacity only when every Codex executor is out, count all in-flight Claude workers, skip un-fallbackable tasks, guard cfg, and honour the other-account rule for reviews
spec: Fix round for T-0083 from opus review T-0093 (merged already on sonnet approve; this task bases on goal/T-0073). (1) daemon.free_slots: unlock the Claude fallback branch only when no enabled execute executor is available, i.e. `not any(ex.enabled and "execute" in ex.roles and not ex.cooling() for ex in pool.executors.values())`, never when the Codex sum is 0 because rows are merely saturated (running == max_parallel); saturated-but-healthy Codex must return 0 so tasks wait for the next tick. (2) Under fallback, capacity = limits.max_parallel_claude_workers minus every in-flight Claude worker of any role: tasks with status running whose assigned_to starts with "claude:", plus execute tasks with pipeline.dispatched_at stamped, no gated_at, and status still queued (the spawn_async window before bus.claim); never below 0. (3) dispatch(): while in fallback mode, skip (leave queued, do not stamp) any execute task whose pool.fallback_tier(complexity) is None, so complexity 9+ waits for Codex instead of being held. (4) Read pool.cfg with .get and the current defaults ("hold" for codex.on_exhausted, 4 for limits.max_parallel_claude_workers) so a pool.toml without [codex] or [limits] cannot raise inside dispatch. (5) spawn.run_worker: derive `avoid` for a review from the reviewed task's assigned_to ("claude:<acct id>") when no explicit account field exists, so pool.pick("review", avoid=...) really avoids the executing account; also have bus.claim record account=<acct id> alongside assigned_to for Claude workers (bus.claim signature unchanged: parse from assigned_to). Tests: tests/test_daemon.py — saturated_codex_returns_zero_not_fallback, fallback_counts_running_claude_roles_and_inflight_dispatches, fallback_skips_complexity_without_tier (complexity 9 stays queued, no dispatched_at), free_slots_survives_missing_cfg_tables; tests/test_spawn.py — review_avoids_executing_account_from_assigned_to (pool.pick receives avoid == the executor's account). Existing tests untouched and green.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py gains the four named tests and tests/test_spawn.py the one named test; all green with existing tests untouched

With the committed pool.toml, four healthy Codex rows at running == max_parallel give free_slots() == 0; with all rows cooling and one running claude scout plus one dispatched-but-unclaimed execute, free_slots() == 2
A complexity-9 execute task is neither dispatched nor held while Codex cools (no pipeline.dispatched_at, status queued)
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency
